C0377.title: To Recover Players' Accounts, They Even Fake Online Romance with Account Thieves
C0377.summary: The report reveals how sellers in online game account trading exploit initial email access to reclaim sold accounts. After-sales staff from an account trading platform tracked down the thief through offline investigation and fake online romance, ultimately handing them over to the police. The case shows how thieves use the initial email—the highest authority credential—to steal accounts.
